name: net_session_config_dialog_on_map_changed
description: NetSessionConfigDialog::OnMapChanged stores the selected map item-data value and toggles the max-player label text. Direct production host: mission.cpp.
known_limits: Tier C only; no VC COFF byte-comparison target exists yet, so tier S remains open.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x41cb90 validates CB_GETCURSEL/CB_GETITEMDATA on the map combo, storage into m_selectedMapIndex at offset 0x60, message id 12352 when the selected map index is 2, message id 12353 otherwise, and SetDlgItemTextA control id 1125.
The native smoke patches USER32 SendMessageA, zLoc::GetMessageString, and CWnd::SetDlgItemTextA, then verifies both label-message branches, selected map storage, and call arguments.
